g.text: All 48 displayed pointwise intervals exclude 1; circles are omitted to keep
the curve readable. Intervals are not simultaneous.
Grey shading spans midnight to equal-site mean civil dawn and equal-site mean civil dusk to midnight.
Intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous; the global participant-cluster-robust curve test is the
inferential test and the display cannot establish a familywise-significant time period. The melEDI axis
uses the specified symlog scale: linear from 0 to 1 lx and base-10 above 1 lx.
